sources: https://flhillsboroughweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/splash.html?interfaceparameter=WebTracCELM#camping (the page's 'Online Camping Reservations' button; refuses plain fetches behind Cloudflare)

hookups.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/eg-simmons-conservation-park ('110 sites; all of which have electricity, potable water, picnic tables, and fire pits', 'All sites offer 30 amp service', '62 sites offer 50 amp service'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 110 RV/trailer/tent sites plus 2 primitive sites with no electricity; site sizes range from 35 to 160 ft in length. Up to two tents or one tent and one RV, eight people and three vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/eg-simmons-conservation-park ('110 campsites 2 primitive sites (no electricity)', 'site sizes range from 35'-160' in length') + Campground Brochure ('A maximum of two tents or one tent and one RV, eight people, and three registered vehicles are permitted per site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Public restrooms, hot and cold shower houses and two RV dump stations.

facilities.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/eg-simmons-conservation-park ('Campers also have access to the park's public restrooms, hot and cold shower houses, and two RV dump stations'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserved online through Hillsborough County's WebTrac site ('Online Camping Reservations'). Camper registration 8 a.m. until an hour before the park closes; checkout 11 a.m.; to extend a stay, re-register by 10 a.m.

booking.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/eg-simmons-conservation-park ('Camping Reservations', 'Online Camping Reservations' -> flhillsboroughweb.myvscloud.com WebTrac) + Campground Brochure ('To learn more about camping and make reservations, visit HCFL.gov/Camping', registration and checkout times), read 2026-10-21

note: Hillsborough County conservation park on Tampa Bay near Ruskin, 18 miles south of Tampa. 700 ft of Tampa Bay beach, fishing pier, kayak rentals at the entry station; 200-acre mangrove bird sanctuary. --Claude
summary: County page + brochure: confirmed $24 base, 30-amp at all sites / 50-amp at 62, water at every site, 110 sites, showers and two dump stations. Changed booking reservable false -> true with the county's WebTrac online reservations, and cleared the derived fcfs 'always' and max_rig_ft 160 (that is the longest SITE length, 35-160 ft). Note dropped its wrong 'FCFS, no advance reservations' line and its hookup/site/rating restatements.
